things.text: Jars of everything. One is labelled DO NOT, in Maple's handwriting.

store.intro: Bells on the door. Flour in the air. Maple's Mercantile sells everything a farm needs and several things it doesn't.

gangsters.intro: Bells on the door, bars on the windows. Maple's Mercantile sells everything, and keeps a ledger of who owes what.

smith.intro: Heat. Hammer. A man who has clearly never been cold in his life.

gangsters.intro: Sparks and engine oil. The smith fixes blades, bats and bumpers, and never asks how they got bent.

things.text: Bottles in every colour. One of them is looking back at you.

potions.intro: It smells like rain and burnt sugar. Wren's shop. Don't touch the purple ones.

gangsters.intro: It smells like rain and burnt sugar. Wren's labels are hand-written and her prices are not up for discussion.

texts.1: Bottles in every colour, every label hand-written. None of them say what's inside, and Wren likes it that way.

hall.intro: The town hall: a long table, a long clock, and a mayor who is very good at long meetings.

gangsters.intro: The town hall: a long table, a long clock, and a mayor who smiles like he's counting the exits.

things.msg: Stew and a chair by the fire. +4 hearts.

things.text: A bed for travellers. Someone has left a boot under it.

inn.intro: The inn: low beams, a fire that never goes out, and Bram behind the bar pretending not to listen.

gangsters.intro: Low beams, a fire that never goes out, and Bram watching the door as much as the bar.

crew_mama_rosa.intro: Mama Rosa's kitchen took over the inn: red sauce, loud plates, and a back table nobody sits at without asking.
crew_mama_rosa.name: Mama Rosa's Kitchen

things.msg: A warm roll, on the house.

bakery.intro: Bread. Just bread, everywhere, in the best possible way.

gangsters.intro: Bread, everywhere. The baker opens at five and knows everyone's business by six.

shop_1.intro: Deuce's arcade: the ovens are cold, the screens are hot. Tokens at the counter, no sore losers.
shop_1.name: Deuce's Arcade

things.msg: A warm roll, on the house.
Patched up. Try not to do that again.

clinic.intro: Clean sheets and a smell of soap. The clinic. Juniper looks you over like a leaking roof.

gangsters.intro: Clean sheets and a smell of soap. Juniper patches up anyone, and never asks how it happened.

shop_3.intro: Doc's back-room clinic: the sign out front still says CLINIC. The one in the back says CASH ONLY.
shop_3.name: Doc's Back Room

things.text: 'A History of the Valley', chapter one: 'Before the town there was the light, and before the light there was the cat.'
'Grumps and How to Cheer Them': mostly blank pages. Someone wrote 'you can't' on the last one.

library.intro: Dust in sunbeams. The library. Theo looks up, then down, then up again.

gangsters.intro: Dust in sunbeams. The library. Theo keeps one eye on his book and one on the door.

texts.0: 'A History of the Valley', chapter one: 'Before the town there was the river, and before the river there was a deal.'
texts.1: 'Street Names and Who Runs Them': every page has been crossed out and written over at least twice.

chapel.intro: Candles and cold stone. Nobody here but the quiet.

gangsters.intro: Candles and cold stone. Nobody here but the quiet, and nobody asks who you are.

crew_marlene.intro: Marlene's trading post: pews pushed back, crates stacked high. Everything here has a price and a story.
crew_marlene.name: Marlene's Trading Post

things.text: A dresser full of potion bottles and one very small sweater.

cottage_a.intro: Wren's cottage. Herbs hang from every beam.

things.text: Fishing tackle, three broken rods, and a photo of a fish bigger than the man holding it.

cottage_b.intro: Finn's place. It smells like the lake.

fishing_hut.intro: Nets on the walls, a stove that smells of trout, and Finn, who has opinions about weather.

things.text: A mouse hole. Something lives there that Orla pretends not to feed.

water_mill.intro: The mill: flour in the air, the big wheel turning the stones through the wall.

things.msg: Tea by the stove. The fog bell rings somewhere above.

things.text: The lamp. Dark, until you bring the lens.

lighthouse.intro: The keeper's room: round walls, charts, and a stair that goes up into the dark.

things.text: The town charter, under glass. Six Alders have signed it.

mansion.intro: Mayor Alder's house: more bookshelves than a mansion needs, and a kettle always on.

gangsters.intro: Mayor Alder's house: more bookshelves than a mansion needs, and a safe everyone pretends not to see.

things.text: A frog in a jar. His name, says the label, is Professor.
The moon, drawn on the board in chalk, with the teleporter marked in a child's hand.

school.intro: The schoolroom. Four desks, one globe with the moon drawn in by hand.

gangsters.intro: The schoolroom. Four desks, one globe, and a list of rules on the board that starts with NO PHONES IN CLASS.

things.text: A shared desk: one end crusted with paint tubes, the other stacked with Theo's notebooks, a ruler laid exactly on the line between.
Half the cottage is canvases, half is books. The line down the middle is chalk.

cottage_c.intro: Lumi and Theo's cottage: paint on one side, paper on the other.

shop_2.intro: Specs' net cafe: screens glowing, cables taped to the floor, and a sign that says NO SNOOPING.
shop_2.name: Specs' Net Cafe

things.text: A rack of rebuilt laptops, each with a sticky note: a price, a name, or just NO.
Cables everywhere, labelled in neat capitals. Specs knows which one is which. Nobody else does.
A dresser of seed tins, every lid labelled by year in the same careful hand. The oldest is older than you.
Seed packets sorted by month. A hoe worn to a crescent.

hazel_house.intro: Hazel's farmhouse smells of soil and bread.

things.text: Three stalls. One has a name carved on the post: CLOVER.

stable.intro: The stable. Hay, tack, and a stall waiting for a horse.

gangsters.intro: The stable. Hay, tack, and a stall waiting for a horse nobody has claimed.

crew_halo.intro: Halo's garage: the stalls hold motorbikes now, and the hay smells of motor oil.
crew_halo.name: Halo's Garage

things.text: Three stalls. One has a name carved on the post: CLOVER.
The skinning bench. Don't look too closely.

lodge.intro: Rook's lodge: woodsmoke, woven rugs, and a bow over the door.

things.text: The vault. Ivy says it's 'mostly for show'. The door is a foot thick.

bank.intro: The bank. Marble floor, one teller window, and the quietest room in town.

gangsters.intro: The bank. Marble floor, one teller window, and two guards trying very hard to look bored.

things.text: Blueprints of the quarry. Someone has drawn a face on the cliff.

quarry_office.intro: Granite's office. Coffee, dust, and a time clock nobody punches.

things.text: Rune rubbings: sun, arch, tree, spiral. Sel has circled the spiral eleven times.

sel_camp.intro: Sel's tent. Rubbings, a caged crystal that hums, ink everywhere.

tam_hut.intro: Tam's hut: wool on every surface and the smell of cider.

things.text: The pot. Green. It bubbles even with no fire under it.

moss_hut.intro: Old Moss's hut. Frogs on the step, a kettle that's never off.

things.text: Rods, nets, and a sign: GONE FISHING.

river_hut.intro: The river hut. Nets drying, fish on ice, nobody home.

rec.intro: Bright lights, the clatter of pins upstairs, a wall of cabinets blinking for attention. The prize counter glitters like a dragon's hoard.

gangsters.intro: Neon on brick, the clatter of pins upstairs, a wall of cabinets blinking for attention. A sign by the door: NO HEAT INSIDE. EVERYBODY PLAYS.

rec_up.intro: Four lanes of polished maple run to four perfect triangles of pins. Somewhere a ball thunders home and the whole floor hums.

gangsters.intro: Four lanes under blacklight, pins glowing like teeth. Somebody's put a chalk line on the wall: HOUSE RECORD.

museum.intro: Glass cases in neat rows, a velvet rope, a little brass bell. The Valley Museum.

gangsters.intro: Glass cases, a velvet rope, a ledger by the tray. The Curio Room.

things.text: Plans pinned flat with chisels: a rocking chair, a bird house, a bed with a moon carved in the headboard.

workshop.intro: Sawdust in the sunbeams and the smell of pine. Tess's workshop: chairs half-built, shelves fully built.

gangsters.intro: Sawdust and engine noise from the street. Tess's workshop builds furniture for every crew in town, and asks nobody's business.

things.hint: A: read the brass plaque (house odds)
